status_note: Approved on 2026-11-23 as written. systems.py refuses to run on anything else. Each CV's author is listed below: nobody may rate a CV they wrote.
provenance: Drafted on 2026-11-23 from the CV texts alone. The 8 CVs had already been through 10 end-to-end searches on 2026-11-22 (no experience band or industry set), so their job lists were seen before these settings were written; they were not used to choose them. The plan asks for settings fixed before any results are seen, so the report must say this.
employment_types_note: Hard filter, the same in settings A and B and for every CV. 'full-time' matches the 10 end-to-end runs. 249 of the 276 snapshot jobs pass it (184 list no type and pass every filter).
rule: A is the candidate's own experience band and industry. B is a neighbouring band (up for the experienced CVs and graduates, down for the two career switchers) and a related industry. Bands: 0-2, 3-5, 6-9, 10+.

e1-marketing-experienced.why: CV states 8 years. Current employer is a beauty brand selling through stores and online. B is the next band up and the agency industry of the first job.

e2-customer-admin-experienced.why: CV states 7 years. Current employer is a medical supplies company. B is the next band down and the telecom company of the previous job.

e3-logistics-experienced.why: CV states 9 years in freight forwarding and warehousing. B is the next band up and a neighbouring supply-chain industry.

g1-finance-graduate.why: Graduate with an audit internship at a CPA firm. B is the next band up and the closest finance industry.

g2-software-graduate.why: Graduate with a software internship. B is the next band up and the payments industry of that internship.

g3-data-analyst-graduate.why: Graduate with a data internship at a retail group. B is the next band up and a related data-heavy industry.

s1-teacher-to-hr-switcher.why: Career switcher; the CV's own profile says 5 years of managing people as a teacher. B is the next band down, matching how little HR experience there is, and the youth charity where the volunteer HR work was done.

s2-marketing-to-design-switcher.why: Career switcher; the CV's own profile says 3 years working with design teams, in a coffee company. B is the next band down, since design experience is new, and the marketing industry.
